_note: Routing corpus for research-survey — an open-ended systematic-investigation method (literature review, controlled experiment, causal tracing, benchmarking, adversarial analysis; the six techniques autoresearch/ablation/bisect/adversarial/hill-climb/sweep). Positives span the invocation families (imperative optimize/debug, symptom-implies-technique, object-first, indirect paraphrase). Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from NAMED peers it is most confusable with: the *-decomposer GRADE mode (each grades ONE specific artifact against a fixed rubric — code/regex/query/type/config/layout/component/proof — not open-ended investigation), deep-research (multi-source web report with citations, not a measured experiment over a live system), tool-stress (the orchestrated MULTI-technique campaign that COMPOSES these techniques — research-survey runs ONE at a time), routing-decomposer (grades a skill description's routing), and skills-studio (authors/evals a skill). routing-eval measures LEXICAL OVERLAP only — indirect paraphrase positives may score low; that is a proxy limit, not a defect.
